==Description==
'''Achoo''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that could have been obtained through the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]] regular track. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote. You can move while performing this emote.

The emote makes the player hold a tissue box. Occasionally, the player will sneeze.

This emote was obtainable at Level 19 of the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]] regular track, which cost {{Bunz|590}} or {{Robux|68}}. The total cost is {{Bunz|5,460}} or {{Robux|1,410}}.
